items.Name: Black Grimoire
items.Description: This aged text feels cold to the touch, and your fingers are numb after handling it. Within its tainted pages are revealed the methods by which a person can summon forth the most heinous of creatures. Interestingly, there are also instructions on how to banish evil once summoned…

items.Name: Cell Key
items.Description: This key allows access to some of the holding cells beneath Helm's Hold.

items.Name: Etched Gem
items.Description: This Gem is inscibed with the symbol of Helm, and the image of his fist sweeping his enemies aside. You also see a pedestal that the gem is supposed to sit upon, possibly near the entrance to the Helm's Hold Keep. You are not sure how so much detail could be held within one gem.…

items.Name: Rare Earth Clay
items.Description: A careful mixture of earth makes this small bit of clay ideal for use as a reagent in magical study. There may once have been a rather long description of this item pressed or carved into its surface, but it appears to have been deliberately smudged.

items.Name: Flask of Water
items.Description: Written on a piece of tape that is stretched across the flask: "For while the water should have generally been proud, having existed far longer than many of those within this world, it could not exist without a solid foundation to settle in upon - and for that, it remained humbl…

items.Name: Puff of Fog
items.Description: This small container appears to hold a swirling puff of fog. The following message delicately inscribed on the surface: "When air became, in its youth, jealous of its place in the world, it sought out ways to assert its power. It floated high in the night air, and obscured the v…

items.Name: Kindling Wood
items.Description: Carved upon this bit of kindling wood is the following phrase: "And the fire was angry that it could not overcome the rain above. The air taunted the fire, knowing that fire needed the air to live. Such is the way of those who have come late in life."

items.Name: Gauntlet Award: First Round
items.Description: Badges like this are given to would-be gladiators participating in the Gauntlet fighting club beneath Neverwinter's Board Laid Bare tavern. This particular award signifies that the bearer has defeated the lowest ranked fighter in the competition. Higher ranked battles can occur,…

items.Name: Gauntlet Award: Second Round
items.Description: Badges like this are given to would-be gladiators participating in the Gauntlet fighting club beneath Neverwinter's Board Laid Bare tavern. This particular award signifies that the bearer has won their second battle in the competition, and may now challenge fighters of still hig…

items.Name: Gauntlet Award: Third Round
items.Description: Badges like this are given to would-be gladiators participating in the Gauntlet fighting club beneath Neverwinter's Board Laid Bare tavern. This particular award signifies that the bearer has defeated all comers, and is now eligible to challenge for ownership of the club. The ba…

items.Name: Gauntlet Championship Award
items.Description: There is only one badge of this type. It signifies that the bearer is the Grand Champion of the Gauntlet fighting club beneath Neverwinter's Board Laid Bare tavern. The owner of this item has defeated all comers, including the group's founder, and has taken the Board Laid Bare t…

items.Name: Gauntlet Key
items.Description: This key opens the door to the back room of Neverwinter's Board Laid Bare tavern, thereby granting access to the Gauntlet combatant's club below.

items.Name: Gauntlet Pass
items.Description: This chit will allow the bearer passage into the secretive Gauntlet combatant's club beneath Neverwinter's Board Laid Bare tavern. It must be presented to the bartender and will be exchanged for a key.

items.Name: Halueth's Rusted Armor
items.Description: This armor once belonged to Lord Halueth Never, but it has barely survived the ages. It was exposed to a damaging amount of moisture over time, although you can still see the quality it must have once had. There is light etching throughout, including a faint image of the symbol …

items.Name: Ceremonial Arrow
items.Description: This item is too flimsy to be of any real use in combat. Obviously it is made for some other purpose related to Halueth Never.

items.Name: Halueth Dig Logbook
items.Description:
This book details the initial search for the tomb of Halueth Never. It is unfinished, the writer obviously falling to the plague before he could include many details, but it does point to the possible locations for three tombs in addition to the one in the Peninsula District.

B…

items.Name: Jones' Key
items.Description: A guard in the Peninsula held this key. He was guarding a door inside a house in the southeast of the district.

items.Name: Letter from Oleff
items.Description: This letter bears the seal of Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar, and indicates that the bearer is in his service. This letter is to be presented to Briley, a young cleric guarding a tomb in the Peninsula District.

items.Name: Jacob's Quill
items.Description: This object bears an inscription in delicate writing. "Jacob in service of Tyr. Truth be revealed in your words."

items.Name: Ceremonial Shield
items.Description: This item is too flimsy to be of any real use in combat. Obviously it is made for some other purpose related to Halueth Never.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Ceremonial Sword
items.Description: This item is too flimsy to be of any real use in combat. Obviously it is made for some other purpose related to Halueth Never.
PropertiesDecoded: Base Item Weight Reduction 10% of Weight

items.Name: Ancient Symbol of Tyr
items.Description: The meticulous carving that went in to this item is evident even through the dust of ages on its surface. This would be a very valuable artifact to the Temple of Tyr, even without the provenance of having possibly belonged to Lord Halueth Never.

items.Name: Briley's Key
items.Description: This is a key to a chest watched over by the Briley

items.Name: Tamora's Brooch
items.Description:
This brooch is not the best of quality, but the inscription on the back likely means it has tremendous sentimental value to someone.

"Yours always. I will return - this I swear. Keep a good thought for me."

The message is dated 1360DR, so it is more than a decade old.

items.Name: Androd's Key
items.Description: This key should unlock all of Androd's chests.

items.Name: Key to the Rumbottom Estate
items.Description: This key grants access to the fabulous Rumbottom Estate in the Blacklake district.

items.Name: Key to Hodge's Estate
items.Description: This key grants access to the Hodge Estate.

items.Name: Moonstone Mask Back Room Key
items.Description: This key enables the bearer to enter the backroom of the Moonstone Mask.

items.Name: Androd Golden Key
items.Description: This looks to be a skeleton key, and is likely good for almost every lock in the Androd Estate.

items.Name: Letter from Ophala
items.Description: This letter is from Ophala Cheldarstorn of the Moonstone Mask. It directs Oleff of the Temple of Tyr to examine the bearer and certify that they are plague-free.

items.Name: Writ from Oleff
items.Description: This writ certifies that the bearer is plague-free. It is signed by Reverend Judge Oleff Uskar, and directed to the attention of Ophala Cheldarstorn of the Moonstone Mask.

items.Name: Note From Hodge
items.Description: This note from Hodge is intended for Ophala Cheldarstorn, and consists of an almost steady stream of profanities and curses. Apparently they have been exchanging such sentiments for a great deal of time, and he is none too pleased with having had to flee his refuge yet again. St…

items.Name: Note
items.Description: "Tooth of the forge"

items.Name: Note
items.Description: "A wall at arms length"

items.Name: Note
items.Description: "A splinter delivered in flight"

items.Name: Pass Coin
items.Description: This coin is the recognized currency of the Moonstone Mask, and entitles the bearer to approach one of the men or women working in the back room.

items.Name: Portrait of Sir Reginald Rumbottom III
items.Description: This portrait is a rather unremarkable likeness of Sir Reginald Rumbottom III. The only things that stand out about it are the strange markings on the back of the canvas. They are largely illegible, but the name "Ophala Cheldarstorn" does appear to be among them.

items.Name: Gaudy Statuette
items.Description: The workmanship responsible for this item is questionable, at best. A small plaque declares it to be a partially nude representation of Ophala Cheldarstorn of the Moonstone Mask, but you cannot see how it could be an accurate likeness.

items.Name: Gilded Urn
items.Description: This urn makes a rather cheap attempt at appearing stately, and may have once held the ashes of a respected but poor merchant or minor noble. More recently it has held delicious-smelling after-dinner mints. It bears a dent that could have come from gripping it at the lip and del…

items.Name: Elemental Wand of Fire
items.Description: This wand is infused with elemental fire, allowing the user to cast a single Burning Hands spell. It will only function in the testing chamber of the Many-Starred Cloak guild tower.
PropertiesDecoded: Burning Hands (2) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Many-Starred Cloak
items.Description: These masterfully crafted cloaks, stitched on both sides with glittering stars, are the guild emblem of the sorcerers and wizards of Neverwinter's fabled Cloaktower. Loyal to Lord Nasher, the Cloakwizards are vital to the city's defense and carry themselves with the appropriatel…

items.Name: Elemental Wand of Earth
items.Description: This wand is infused with energy from the elemental plane of earth, allowing the user to cast a single Stoneskin spell. It will only function in the testing chamber of the Many-Starred Cloak guild tower.

items.Name: Scented Fetish
items.Description: Nyatar created this item to aid in rescuing the animals in the Blacklake zoo. It grants the bearer very specific use of certain ranger and druid abilities, allowing communication with the captive animals.

items.Name: Elemental Wand of Water
items.Description: This wand is infused with energy partially from the elemental plane of water, allowing the user to cast a single Slow spell. It will only function in the testing chamber of the Many-Starred Cloak guild tower.

items.Name: Elemental Wand of Air
items.Description: This wand is infused with energy partially from the elemental plane of air, allowing the user to cast a single Color Spray spell. It will only function in the testing chamber of the Many-Starred Cloak guild tower.
PropertiesDecoded: Color Spray (2) Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Zoo Key Copy
items.Description: This key apparently opens a number of locks within the zoo operated by Montgomery "Sureshot" Weatherson. Nyatar's animal companion stole the original, and Nyatar made copies.

items.Name: Eltoora's Key
items.Description: This key belongs to Eltoora of the Many-Starred Cloak. It allows entry to the various workshops the mage guild has established around the city.

items.Name: Transport Via Plants Scroll
items.Description: This magic scroll is to be used near the large tree outside the zoo in the Blacklake district. It will transform that single large tree into a portal through which the animals of the zoo can escape. After they are through, the druid Nyatar will see to their well-being.

items.Name: Dydd's Journal
items.Description:
This is the journal of one Dydd, another contestant in Mutamin's Challange. The last entry seems to make reference to the riddle with the numbered doors in the room where his body lies:

Curse this riddle! As near as I can tell the grand daughters that the riddle mentions expand…

items.Name: Wanev's Wardstone
items.Description: A tower, framed by forked lightning, has been engraved into this rough stone, as have a number of arcane symbols. On the back is the sigil of Wanev, a wizard of Port Llast. It appears to be a wardstone granting access to his tower south of town.

items.Name: Port Llast Mine Key
items.Description: Mayor Kendrack made this key available upon learning that the escaped convict, Yesgar, had locked himself within the Port Llast mines. While the key will open the mine's main entrance, other keys will be still be required beyond that point.

items.Name: Imaskarran Tome of Death
items.Description:
This heavy and tattered tome is labeled with a large and ancient rune that translates simply to 'Death'. Among its more interesting passages is the following:

"The Ettercap Silk Gland is a substance known to augment and accentuate the capabilities of other reagents, and is ther…

items.Name: Imaskarran Tome of Fire
items.Description:
This heavy and tattered tome is labeled with a large and ancient rune that translates simply to 'Fire'. Among its more interesting passages is the following:

"The Fire Beetle Belly is an amazing organ that manages to retain its full heat, even after the beetle's death. When com…

items.Name: Imaskarran Tome of Ice
items.Description:
This heavy and tattered tome is labeled with a large and ancient rune that translates simply to 'Ice'. Among its more interesting passages is the following:

"Calling forth the icy grip of death within the constraints of a spell too often results in the death of the caster and t…

items.Name: Imaskarran Tome of Life
items.Description:
This heavy and tattered tome is labeled with a large and ancient rune that translates simply to 'Life'. Among its more interesting passages is the following:

"By using an Endure Elements spell to protect their essences, a Fen Berry and a Quartz crystal can be combined. The powe…

items.Name: Imaskarran Tome of Resonance
items.Description:
This heavy and tattered tome is labeled with a large and ancient rune that translates simply to 'Resonance'. Among its more interesting passages is the following:

"The Ettercap Silk Gland is a substance known to augment and accentuate the capabilities of other reagents, and is …

items.Name: Wyvern's Ear
items.Description: This ragged ear bears a tattoo of the Bastion, a well-known prison of Waterdeep. The number corresponds to that of an escaped convict named Wyvern. Kendrack, the Mayor of Port Llast, will be pleased to learn that its former owner has fallen upon misfortune.

items.Name: Stirge's Ear
items.Description: This ragged ear bears a tattoo of the Bastion, a well-known prison of Waterdeep. The number corresponds to that of an escaped convict named Stirge. Kendrack, the Mayor of Port Llast, will be pleased to learn that its former owner has fallen upon misfortune.

items.Name: Delilah's Ear
items.Description: This ragged ear bears a tattoo of the Bastion, a well-known prison of Waterdeep. The number corresponds to that of an escaped convict named Delilah. Kendrack, the Mayor of Port Llast, will be pleased to learn that its former owner has fallen upon misfortune.

items.Name: Head of the Bugbear Chieftain
items.Description: Caked with dirt and half-dried blood, this gruesome trophy should be sufficient evidience to prove the death of the bugbear chieftain waylaying travellers along the North Road.

items.Name: Crystal Egg
items.Description: Light shimmers within this finely engraved crystal egg. Dangling from a simple gold chain, it may be the prize required to complete Mutamin's Challenge in the basement of the Green Griffon Inn.

items.Name: Crystal Frog
items.Description: Fashioned from cut crystal, this frog seems so lifelike that you fear it might jump from your hand to shatter on the ground below. It may be the prize required to complete Mutamin's Challenge in the basement of the Green Griffon Inn.

items.Name: Crystal Insect
items.Description: Legs wide and crystalline wings spread, this beautiful insectoid statuette may be the prize required to complete Mutamin's challenge in the basement of the Green Griffon Inn.

items.Name: Crystal Skull
items.Description: Forboding and almost weightless, this faceted crystal skull may be the prize needed to complete Mutamin's Challenge in the basement of the Green Griffon Inn.

items.Name: Green Griffon Puzzle Door Key
items.Description: It is strange to work so hard for something so small. This key was found in the final puzzle room within Mutamin's Challenge Dungeon in the Green Griffon Inn. It offers the chance for escape.

items.Name: Green Griffon Basement Key
items.Description: The popular Green Griffon Inn, situated between Luskan and Port Llast, is a large establishment and full of secrets. This key grants its wielder access to the Inn's well-locked basement.

items.Name: Mausolem Key
items.Description: Cold as death itself, this key unlocks a mausoleum found in a graveyard along the road to Luskan. The mausoleum is said to house the bones of one of Luskan's feared Arcane Brothers.

items.Name: Wedding Ring
items.Description: An inscription around the outside of this simple wedding band reads "To Leah, my love for all of my life. Your husband, Gerrol."

items.Name: Head of the Orc Chieftain
items.Description: The head of the Orc Chieftain from the network of caves beneath the North Road.

items.Name: Tomb Key
items.Description: The foul stench of the undead who once held it still permeates this half-rusted key. While it's hard to say for sure, it seems fair to assume that the key will open a further lock within the Arcane Brother's tomb where it was found.

items.Name: Yesgar's Ear
items.Description: This ragged ear bears a tattoo of the Bastion, a well-known prison of Waterdeep. The number corresponds to that of an escaped convict named Yesgar. Kendrack, the Mayor of Port Llast, will be pleased to learn that its former owner has fallen upon misfortune.

items.Name: Zamithra's Room Key
items.Description: Stout and heavy, this key has been designed to withstand frequent use. It bears the mark of the Green Griffon Inn and a room number on the second floor.

items.Name: Zamithra's Strongbox Key
items.Description: Stout and heavy, this key has been designed to withstand frequent use. It bears the mark of the Green Griffon Inn and a room number on the second floor. Judging by the key's intricacy, however, it fits something more than just an inn-room door. It's likely for one of the strongb…

items.Name: Zor's Ear
items.Description: This ragged ear bears a tattoo of the Bastion, a well-known prison of Waterdeep. The number corresponds to that of an escaped convict named Zor. Kendrack, the Mayor of Port Llast, will be pleased to learn that its former owner has fallen upon misfortune.

items.Name: Diplomatic Pass
items.Description: This forged diplomatic pass was given to you by Aarin Gend. It designates the bearer as an official representative of the far-off land of Mulhorand come to deal with the leader of the Arcane Brotherhood. The pass bears the magical seal that will allow the bearer to pass unharmed…

items.Name: Letter to Neva
items.Description:
Neva,

Our efforts with the Orc Clans and Uthgardt tribes continue and we are close to a breakthrough. The resulting army, already strong, should be enough to bring about the New and Holy Empire. Not all is as smooth as hoped, however, as some meddlers are proving to be of small…

items.Name: Letter to Solomon
items.Description:
Solomon,

The Old Ones, may they live forever, seek an ancient artifact said to be in the vicinity of Port Llast. I have sent agents to retrieve it but, for you, I have a greater task: There are meddlers about, the very same who thwarted Desther's good work in Neverwinter. If yo…

items.Name: Solomon's Ring
items.Description: This ring was given to you by Solomon, an odd-looking halfling who approached you and offered the ring as a gift to a 'Hero of Neverwinter.'

items.Name: Alhelor's Tooth
items.Description: This tooth was pulled from the jaw of Alhelor, the Black Wolf. Neurik, a priest in Port Llast, will be glad to see such evidence of the lycanthrope's demise.

items.Name: Setara's Gem
items.Description: This is a magical gem that appears to have once been part of some greater item. It was owned by Setara, the forest witch.

items.Name: Zamithra's Gem
items.Description: This is a magical gem that appears to have once been part of some greater item. It was owned by Zamithra, a mercenary woman.

items.Name: Wanev's Gem
items.Description: This is a magical gem that appears to have once been part of some greater item. It was owned by Wanev the mage.

items.Name: The Journal of Sir Karathis Ironheart
items.Description:
May the celestial armies rain fire upon mine enemy, Alhelor! Alhelor the Werewolf, Alhelor the Alpha Male... I have hunted him for years and with a simple bite, he has turned me into the very thing I hate! No doubt he hides beneath his merchant guise even now...

As the lycanthr…

items.Name: Debugging Ring
items.Description: Bran's adventuring ring which can be returned to Neurik in Port Llast for a reward.
PropertiesDecoded: Greater Restoration (13) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day
Greater Sanctuary (18) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day
Time Stop (17) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day
Wail of the Banshee (17) Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day
Immunity: Spells by Level Level 9 or Lower

items.Name: Urth's Ring
items.Description: Urth's adventuring ring which can be returned to Neurik in Port Llast for a reward.

items.Name: Bran's Ring
items.Description: Bran's adventuring ring which can be returned to Neurik in Port Llast for a reward.

items.Name: Geth's Ring
items.Description: Geth's adventuring ring which can be returned to Neurik in Port Llast for a reward.

items.Name: Silver Charm
items.Description: Formed with the blessings of Neurik, priest of Port Llast, this smooth-surfaced charm has the power to save the souls of those recently afflicted with lycanthropy. Beyond that one purpose, it is a very weak charm indeed.

items.Name: Tome of Death Research Notes
items.Description:
This parchment lists Eltoora's research notes regarding the Tome of Death. Simply put, she writes:

One Ettercap Silk Gland mixed with one Skeleton Knuckle. Cast Improved Invisibility.

items.Name: Tome of Fire Research Notes
items.Description:
This parchment lists Eltoora's research notes regarding the Tome of Fire. Simply put, she writes:

One Fire Beetle Belly mixed with one Quartz Crystal. Cast Fireball.

items.Name: Tome of Ice Research Notes
items.Description:
This parchment lists Eltoora's research notes regarding the Tome of Ice. Simply put, she writes:

One Skeleton's Knuckle mixed with one Quartz Crystal. Cast Mage Armor.

items.Name: Tome of Life Research Notes
items.Description:
This parchment lists Eltoora's research notes regarding the Tome of Life. Simply put, she writes:

One Fen Berry mixed with one Quartz Crystal. Cast Endure Elements.

items.Name: Tome of Resonance Research Notes
items.Description:
This parchment lists Eltoora's research notes regarding the Tome of Resonance. Simply put, she writes:

One Fen Berry mixed with one Ettercap Silk Gland. Cast Lightning Bolt.

items.Name: Letter to Vardoc
items.Description:
Vardoc.

The Old Ones call you to battle. What was once a gnat has become a poisonous asp at the side of the cult. You know who I send you against. Solomon failed against them, as did Agent Neva. You, I trust, shall not.

When you are done, return to Luskan and we shall dine tog…

items.Name: Ceremonial Dagger
items.Description: The blade of this dagger, shaped like a flame, is cold to the touch, yet the hilt, looking like a skeleton, feels warm. While it isn't much of a weapon, it obviously has a symbolic or ceremonial purpose.

items.Name: Revat's Ring
items.Description: This broad-banded iron ring is large and heavy, intended for a man's hand. Those who knew its owner, Revat's father, will recognize it as his and may be more prone to trust the one who bears it.

items.Name: Initiate's Primer
items.Description:
The letters swim before your eyes, shaping themselves into text that you can understand. This book seems to be a basic guide for priestly initiates who took care of the ancient tomb in which it was found. One passage catches your eye...

"In the early years of the reign of the T…

items.Name: Golem Signet Ring
items.Description: A signet ring of the so-called Creator Race. Golems, guarding the deeper passages of crypt in which it was found, have demanded it.

items.Name: Seal Key
items.Description: This key unlocks the seal between the rooms of the crypt of the so-called Creator Race. The key belonged to the first of the golems who have been guarding the place for untold millennia.

items.Name: Complete History of the Creator Ruins
items.Description: The letters in this book swim before your eyes, finally shaping themselves into text you are capable of understanding. The book speaks of many things and appears to prove, beyond the shadow of a doubt, that a creator race lived in these ruins. A certain passage catches your eye.…

items.Name: Creator Scroll
items.Description: An ancient, crumbling scroll that reads: 'Thurth mog lama gat rag.'

items.Name: Seal Key
items.Description: This key unlocks the seal between the rooms of the crypt of the so-called Creator Race. The key belonged to the second of the golems who have been guarding the place for untold millennia.

items.Name: Creator Scroll
items.Description: An ancient, crumbling scroll that reads: 'Shub shoggoth hastur hastur; nog sothot bl'syu'.

items.Name: History Scroll
items.Description:
The alien text on the aging scroll before you swims and distorts, finally forming a language that you can understand.

"Faerun was once ruled by a cruel and ancient race, known as the Creators, who were left in stasis during the great ice age."

items.Name: History Scroll
items.Description:
The alien text on this ancient scroll swims before your eyes before forming into a language you can understand.

"The Creator race forced a group of slaves to protect them through the ice age."

items.Name: Stolen Seal Key
items.Description: This key unlocks the seal between the rooms of the crypt of the so-called Creator Race. The key once belonged to the third of the golems who have been guarding the place for untold millennia but it was stolen by a thief whose dead body was found nearby.

items.Name: Thief's Journal
items.Description:
A page ripped from a journal, which reads:

Day 1: Stole some loot. Drank ale. Wench not friendly.

Day 2: Stole some more loot. Drank more ale. Wench more friendly.

Day 3: Stole some more loot. Head hurts. Heard rumour about better loot in caves. Wench might be more friendly i…

items.Name: Druid Bridge Key
items.Description: This key, fashioned from ironwood, bears the markings of Archdruid Aawill's druid grove.

items.Name: Ring of the Fourth Circle
items.Description: This ring is given to a druid upon successfully challenging for membership to the Fourth Circle of Archdruid Aawill's grove.
PropertiesDecoded: Summon Creature I (2) Cast Spell 1 Use/Day

items.Name: Ring of the Third Circle
items.Description: This ring is given to a druid upon successfully challenging for membership to the Third Circle of Archdruid Aawill's grove.

items.Name: Ring of the Second Circle
items.Description: This ring is given to a druid upon successfully challenging for membership to the Second Circle of Archdruid Aawill's grove.

items.Name: Ring of the First Circle
items.Description: This ring is given to a druid upon successfully challenging for membership to the First Circle of Archdruid Aawill's grove.

items.Name: Spirit Poison
items.Description: A poison to kill the Spirit of the Wood, found at a campsite in the Neverwinter Wood.
PropertiesDecoded: Alcohol, Spirits Cast Spell Single Use

items.Name: Relmar's Journal
items.Description:
This is a journal, obviously written by the dwarf Relmar before he went insane. It details much of his journey to the Spirit's realm. There are several sections of particular note.

Entry # 32.
Word came down from Maugrim in the tower in Luskan today. I'm being sent to Neverwint…

items.Name: Dead Animal
items.Description: The carcass of this animal is beginning to stink.

items.Name: Dead Body
items.Description: This rigid corpse is curled into a fetal position, its stricken features indecipherable.

items.Name: Troll Key
items.Description: A putrid slime coats the grooves and etchings of this horrid key. It was found in the troll caves that emerge onto the plains east of Port Llast and no doubt unlocks some further horror there within.

items.Name: Mirror of Vanity
items.Description: The magic Mirror of Vanity offers the viewer an image of themselves that is incredibly attractive. In fact, the image is so perfect that many viewers become lost in the illusion, believing themselves to hold greater physical charms than they truly do.

items.Name: Troll Note
items.Description:
A letter; the hand writing is blood stained but part of it is legible:

"Dear Amatia:

These caves are deep and dangerous; we've found layers and layers of caves - but there is construction down at the bottom, and the crypts we seek.

We tried to get Darius out, but barely escap…

items.Name: Treatise on the Spirit of the Wood
items.Description: This musty old tome appears to be the type of book that was written and never read. It is a long, boring text written by a druid, Jordius Caini Getafix the Third, several hundred years ago. It uses large, complicated and often seemingly meaningless words to discuss his observati…

items.Name: Setara's Key
items.Description: The home of the witchwoman, Setara, in the Neverwinter Wood holds many secrets. Perhaps this wrought-iron key will bring some of them to light...

items.Name: Barracks Key
items.Description: Heavy and dull, this iron key fits the barracks at the archeologists' camp on the road east of Port Llast.

items.Name: Karlat's Burning Wand
items.Description: This wand is an extremely simple to use wand that casts the spell Burning Hands. The wand need only be waved and no arcane knowledge is required to use it. It was likely the very first wand given to a young apprentice mage.

items.Name: Karlat's Protection Wand
items.Description: This wand was used to cast protections on Karlat while he was summoning fiends. Anyone attempting to summon a fiend without protection will quickly have the beast at their throat.
PropertiesDecoded: Protection from Alignment (2) Cast Spell 1 Charge/Use

items.Name: The Oath of Belial, Lord of Fire
items.Description: This is the written oath of the demon Belial, Lord of Fire.

items.Name: The Oath of Karlat Jhareg
items.Description: This is the written oath of the sorcerer and half-lich, Karlat Jhareg.

items.Name: The Oath of Quint Jhareg
items.Description: This is the written oath of the madman and former cleric of Lathander, Quint Jhareg.

items.Name: The Phylactery of Karlat Jhareg
items.Description: This is the phylactery of the sorcerer and half-lich, Karlat Jhareg. It is empty and whatever essence of Karlat was once there has long since passed.

items.Name: Peasant's Brooch
items.Description: This simple brooch has a short engraving: "To my dear son Erik. You will always be in my heart. Love, Ma."

items.Name: Silverback's Head
items.Description: This is the head of the dire wolf, Silverback. She preyed upon cattle from a cave near the Charwood.

items.Name: Charwood Cultist's Journal
items.Description: I have killed them. Killed them all yet still they come, again and again! All of this and I have yet to find the Old One's precious artifact. I am at the edge of my sanity but I must press on. To return to Luskan's iron tower empty-handed is to tempt the wrath of our great leade…

items.Name: Castle Jhareg Key of Judgment
items.Description: This key was given to you by the spirit who stands guard over Jhareg Castle. It will unlock the path to the brothers Jhareg, imprisoned above.

items.Name: Another Letter in a Strange Hand
items.Description:
This note was found in the west passage of Castle Jhareg's main floor. It chastises you in its graceful scrawl:

"Just as a candle's flame is thrust into darkness, 'tis the destiny of a Judge to be surrounded by deceit. But even as a forgotten candle gutters and goes out, so too…

items.Name: Another Letter in a Strange Hand
items.Description:
This note was found in the eastern passage of Castle Jhareg's main floor. It chastises you in its graceful scrawl:

"To be Judge is to be a ship upon a sea of great Regret. If you shift the ballast of your Compassion wholly to starboard or to port, you will capsize and be Lost b…

items.Name: Another Letter in a Strange Hand
items.Description:
This note was found in the central passage of Castle Jhareg's main floor. It congratulates you in its graceful scrawl:

"Straight is the path of True Justice and narrow are its ways. Though no choice is free of Consequence, you have chosen wisely and earned your due reward. Reme…

items.Name: Letter by a Strange Hand
items.Description:
Written in a strange but delicate hand, this note was found alongside a key in the foyer of Castle Jhareg. It appears to be a riddle of some sort and reads as follows:

"The Three Paths of Justice

"Wary must be the Judge and straight His course, for His one hand is burnt by the…

items.Name: Castle Jhareg Riddle Key
items.Description: This key was found in the foyer of Castle Jhareg. An accompanying note advised you to choose wisely between the three paths available to you.

items.Name: Castle Jhareg: Karlat's Key
items.Description: This is the key to the room where Karlat Jhareg has been confined.

items.Name: Castle Jhareg: Quint's Key
items.Description: This is the key to the room where Quint Jhareg has been confined.

items.Name: Gulgash's Heart
items.Description: A faint pulse still seems to beat within this small and twisted heart. It belonged to the imp, Gulgash. The creature used to serve Wanev, a wizard who maintains his tower to the south of Port Llast.

items.Name: Treatise on Forgotten Heroes
items.Description: This book is full of stories about the deeds of ancient heroes. A particular passage has been marked: The Mirialis Clan, led by the great warrior Maegal, braved near certain death to rid their lands of the Black Lich and his minions.

items.Name: Wanev's Bedroom Journal
items.Description: This appears the be a journal of one Wanev, a mage. It reads: "Curse the demon ale! Dammit! Dammit! Dammit! I have no idea where I've put the ingredients for the recipe. How drunk was I? What was the blonde's name? Curses! If I can't find the ingredients, I can't get into my den…

items.Name: Wanev's Cookbook
items.Description: This appears to be a recipe for something revolting. It reads: "Por. Stew - Slaad Tongues ground with fire beetle belly make the base. Place in brazier. Add 2 parts skeleton knuckles and stir. Note to self: Smells disgusting. Drink heavily before mixing."

items.Name: Wanev's Cottage Key
items.Description: A tag tied to this well-ornamented piece of tin identifies it as the key to a Port Llast cottage owned by Wanev, a local wizard.

items.Name: Wanev's Lab Journal
items.Description: This appears to be plans for tower construction written by one Wanev, a mage. A section catches your eye: "At last my tower defences are complete! The gates require my wardstone and the caves are heavily guarded. Note to self: The bugbears are idiots. They simply must learn not …

items.Name: Wanev's Summoning Room Key
items.Description: A demon head adorns this saw-toothed key, as does the sigil of Wanev, a well-known wizard of the Port Llast area. It presumably opens the door to his summoning room.

items.Name: Letter to Quint Jhareg
items.Description:
Dear Brother Quint,

Here are the alchemical instructions you requested on your last pilgrimage to the temple. Hopefully they will be of use to you as you continue to bring the people of Charwood to the Morninglord's grace.

May the dawn ever greet you,
Brother Brightmane

-----…

items.Name: Explorer's Journal
items.Description:
Though this book has been severely damaged by exposure to the elements, large parts of it are surprisingly legible.

Included in its pages are translations of the runic language used by the ancient Netherese.

The remainder seems to be the personal journal of an unnamed explorer…

items.Name: Old Scroll
items.Description:
This weathered scroll is severely time-worn and covered with almost-indecipherable runes. There is a hand-written translation across the bottom, showing this to be some manner of religious text written by a Netherese priest. Part of the translation is of particular note:

"The l…

items.Name: Child's Bear
items.Description: The large, stuffed doll is damaged by the marks of countless small, sharp teeth. Blood stains it in several spots. A small name has been embroidered into its torn chest: "Tamlen Whitesnow."

items.Name: Ganon's Journal
items.Description:
I find I've grown fond of the monsters in these caves. They are savage, violent, and easily whipped into a frenzy by my puppet ogre mage Dergiab. Not entirely unlike the rest of us who have turned following Maugrim into a religion... He the puppeteer, we his willing puppets.

An…

items.Name: Dergiab's Head
items.Description: This ragged trophy is the head of Dergiab, an ogre mage threatening Gerrol and the other farmers along the North Road out of Port Llast.

items.Name: Journal Fragment
items.Description: This seems to be a fragment of someone's journal. The only words that can be made out are: "I have hunted him for years and with a simple bite, he has turned me into the very thing I hate! I could not bear it if those boys remain werewolves! I shall go and try to discover what h…

items.Name: High Captains' Seal
items.Description: This seal, imbued with the magic of the Host Tower of the Arcane, is used by the High Captains to mark important documents relevant to city business.

items.Name: Cultist Journal
items.Description: This is the personal journal of one of the cult members. Most of the entries are detailed observations about a woman named Esthelia, who might have been another member of the search party. Sandwiched in between the sexual commentary are a few entries about the duties of the grou…

items.Name: Cultist Journal
items.Description:
This is the journal of a cult member. It would appear that at one point in time, this cultist was a nobleman, due to the constant reminiscences of the "days of wealth and privilege."

Excerpt:
"I amused myself today with memories of the annual fox-hunt at the Vintner Estate. The…

items.Name: Cultist Journal
items.Description:
This is the journal of a cult member. It details the search for the Words of Power.
Excerpt:
"All glory to the coming Queen of the Old Ones. Today I had to deal with a traitor in our midst. Jerica was walking beside me as I discussed the possibility of another foray into that cu…

items.Name: Teleport Scroll
items.Description:
This parchment bears a powerful enchantment and a single command word of the type used to activate a magic portal. Mages and sorcerers often employ such scrolls as 'keys' to protect the entrances to their lairs or laboratories.

When read while standing within the area of an app…

items.Name: Book
items.Description:
Barun's catalog of weapon and armor modifications.

Toss the magical weapon and the component I require to improve it onto my forge and I'll give it a whack with my hammer.
You'll need to pay me first, of course.

Armor and Axes:
Chromatic Breastplate: Requires a diamond and a s…

items.Name: Note
items.Description: The note reads, "I have paid you well for your services. You must help bolster the defences of this cave complex. My orc warriors will probably be unable to stop the elite warriors of Neverwinter." The note is signed by King Obould.

items.Name: Pass Amulet
items.Description: There is a picture of a golem on one side of this amulet and a rune of warding on the other.

items.Name: Ritual Book
items.Description:
This tome details the process of capturing a dragon's essence within a dragon sphere:

The ritual is most effective when used upon a newly hatched wyrm whose growth has been accelerated using spells and enchantments; a beast whose mind is still empty and pure. Only these have th…

items.Name: Dragon Sphere
items.Description: This sphere is roughly the size of an ogre's head and appears to be made of polished black stone, though it is far lighter than one would first expect. The flawless surface is cool to the touch and seems to draw all light into it.

items.Name: Dead Dragon Sphere
items.Description:
This sphere is roughly the size of an ogre's head and appears to be made of polished black stone, though it is far lighter than one would first expect.

The sphere radiates a powerful heat, and on closer inspection there appears to be a winged shape lying motionless beneath the …

items.Name: Full Dragon Sphere
items.Description:
This sphere is roughly the size of an ogre's head and appears to be made of polished black stone, though it is far lighter than one would first expect.

The sphere radiates a powerful heat, and on closer inspection there appears to be a draconic shape slowly moving below the smo…

items.Name: Key
items.Description: The handle of this heavy, ornate key is fashioned into the likeness of an ancient red wyrm - a replica of the mighty Klauth himself.

items.Name: Lillian's Musings
items.Description: This text appears to discuss some sort of connection between star sapphires and snow globes. Its meaning is not entirely clear to you.

items.Name: Snow Globe
items.Description: Roughly the size of an ogre's fist, this crystal sphere is far heavier than it would appear. Inside the globe can be seen an exquisitely detailed miniature realm, right down to the tiny figures of dwarves and dryads populating the landscape. From time to time the position of the…

items.Name: Star Sapphire
items.Description: Its size is impressive, with a unique quality and cut. This semi-precious stone has great value, particularly for those interested in the history of the Cheroux family.

items.Name: Gate Key
items.Description: This is the key to the gate of the Elk Tribe enclave.

items.Name: Word of Power
items.Description: Even in its dormant state, the magic contained within this artifact is undeniable. The surface of this heavy stone tablet tingles with raw energy and untapped potential, and the face and back are inscribed with the strange runes of a long forgotten alien tongue. The arcane symbo…

items.Name: Bounty Hunter's Writ
items.Description:
Writ of Authorization

This writ grants the bearer the authority to use any and all means necessary to bring the orc bandits Vaath and Guzud to justice.

A reward of 500 gold pieces will be paid upon delivery of the head of either bandit to my person.

Rolkid of the Mighty Lance

items.Name: Crystal Robes
items.Description: The delicate material of these robes emits an eerie glow that hints at the powerful magic contained within.

items.Description:

items.Name: White Portal Key
items.Description: This key gives you access to the laboratory of the Order of the Many Starred Cloak through the portal in Eltoora's mage shop.

items.Name: Defense Council Journal
items.Description:
This notebook identifies the bearer as an official representative of Tyr's justice in Rolgan's murder trial and explains the rules of court, including the right for defense council to question any of the participants involved before the trial begins.

To aid you in your task Neu…

items.Name: Plague-Ridden Blankets
items.Description: Though no longer contagious, these blankets show obvious signs of having once been contaminated with the Wailing Death. Anyone who used them was certain to have contracted the disease.

items.Name: Feather of Peace
items.Description: This feather, plucked from a snow dove, is a symbol among the Uthgardt identifying the bearer as an envoy of peace. The markings on this particular token appear to belong to those of the Elk tribe.

items.Name: Dreamcatcher
items.Description: Among the Uthgardt, dreamcatchers are often exchanged to symbolize reconciliation and a willingness to repair damaged relations or resume broken alliances. This particular ornament bears the distinctive marks of the Elk tribe.

items.Name: Letter
items.Description:
The text of this brief letter is written in a plain and unremarkable script:

Dearest Mathilda:

I meant to send this note to offer you words of comfort, but even in a letter I cannot lie to you, my love. In the morning I am being sent out on patrol to verify reports of a strang…

items.Name: Key
items.Description: This key allows entrance into Fort Ilkard.

items.Name: Bret's Wedding Band
items.Description: Bret's wife will recognize anyone bearing this plain gold band as a messenger sent by her husband.

items.Name: Eckel's Note
items.Description: This is a note from Eckel to his wife giving detailed instructions regarding the sale of the crops produced by their farm.

items.Name: Arness's Head
items.Description: This is the head of Arness, sub-chieftain of the Uthgardt Elk tribe.

items.Name: Plague Cure
items.Description: This is a large batch of the cure created to counter the effects of the Wailing Death.

items.Name: Homestead Journal
items.Description:
Blood stains the cover and many of the pages of this diary. Most of the entries are written in a firm, bold hand and describe the day-to-day activities of a settler family as they worked the fields and tilled the land. The final entry is written in a finer script:

"The Uthgardt…

items.Name: Zokan's Head
items.Description: The is the head of Zokan Thunderer, legendary chieftain of the Uthgardt Elk tribe.

items.Name: Islegood's Complete History of Flight
items.Description: This book appears to be the final volume in Islegood's Complete History of Flight, a legendary series written well over a century ago. The work gives a detailed overview of the evolution of flight, both magical and mundane, throughout Faerun's history, beginning with the earlies…

items.Name: Islegood's Complete History of Seafaring
items.Description: This book is the final volume in one of the lesser known works of Islegood, the famous historian and chronicler of the North who died well over a century ago. The Complete History of Seafaring chronicles the evolution of ship building, navigation and mapping methods. It also con…

items.Name: Islegood's Complete History of Horses
items.Description: This is the final volume in Islegood's highly acclaimed Complete History of Horses. While earlier books in the series discuss equine breeding, the proper training methods for horses and a variety of recreational riding methods, this work deals exclusively with mounted combat. Th…

items.Name: Blue Gem
items.Description: This is a blue gem of little intrinsic value. All light passing through the translucent stone takes on a bluish hue.

items.Name: Green Gem
items.Description: This is a green gem of little intrinsic value. All light passing through the translucent stone takes on a greenish hue.

items.Name: Orange Gem
items.Description: This is an orange gem of little intrinsic value. All light passing through the translucent stone takes on an orange hue.

items.Name: Purple Gem
items.Description: This is a purple gem of little intrinsic value. All light passing through the translucent stone takes on a purplish hue.

items.Name: Red Gem
items.Description: This is a red gem of little intrinsic value. All light passing through the translucent stone takes on a reddish hue.

items.Name: Yellow Gem
items.Description: This is a yellow gem of little intrinsic value. All light passing through the translucent stone takes on a yellowish hue.

items.Name: Blue Powder
items.Description: This is a small paper packet full of blue powder.

items.Name: Red Powder
items.Description: This is a small paper packet full of red powder.

items.Description: This is a small paper packet full of yellow powder.

items.Name: Key
items.Description: This key opens the altar of the Word of Power in the Creator Race Ruins.

items.Name: Adventurer's Note
items.Description:
An adventurer's journal; most of the pages are torn and blood-stained, but a few notes can be made out still:

"The golems are invincible; it is only luck that has them move so slowly they cannot keep up.

"There must be some way to defeat them; the strange wizard in the garden …

items.Name: Golem Key
items.Description: This key was possessed by the guardian golems in the Creator Race Ruins; it opens the door they were protecting.

items.Name: Fairy Bottle
items.Description: Through the dark glass of this bottle you see a small creature. It ignores you, concentrating instead on playing a variety of musical instruments that are scattered about the inside of the bottle.
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Time Crystal
items.Description: This remarkable stone is obviously a time crystal. According to legend, the power of these stones can be used as a catalyst to facilitate the process of time travel. However, most accounts indicate that the magic of the time crystals can only be unlocked when used in conjuction …
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Old One Defenses
items.Description:
This note appears to be instructions from a high priest to one of his underlings describing how to enter the central vault of the complex:

As a keeper of the sacred artifacts you must understand the secrets of our inner sanctum. Only the rituals of smoke, light and sound will u…

items.Name: Lokar's Ring
items.Description: This is the signet ring of Lokar, leader of the Creator Race's human slaves. It identifies the bearer as an ally of the underground slave resistance.

items.Name: Temple Defenses
items.Description:
This note appears to be instructions from a high priest to one of his underlings describing how to enter the central vault of the complex:

As a keeper of the sacred artifacts you must understand the secrets of our inner sanctum. Only the rituals of smoke, light and sound will u…

items.Name: Translation Amulet
items.Description:
The magic of this amulet translates all communication, verbal or otherwise, into a language both speaker and listener can understand. Such a device must be equipped for its magic to work.

The use of these powerful charms enabled ancient races to organize and command the massive…

items.Name: Stasis Scroll
items.Description: When activated, this scroll will place a person into a stasis sleep for ten thousand years. While in stasis, the magic of the scroll will render the person completely invulnerable and undetectable. After ten thousand years, they will awaken unharmed and unchanged as if only an i…
PropertiesDecoded: Unique Power Cast Spell Unlimited Uses/Day

items.Name: Ultarg Seeds
items.Description: At first glance these appear to be tiny rocks or pebbles. However, in truth these are the seeds of the legendary Ultarg Tree. Though an exceptionally hardy species the Ultarg takes 10,000 years to reach maturity and bear fruit, making it one of the rarest plants in Faerun.

items.Name: Guzud's Head
items.Description: This is the decapitated head of the infamous orc bandit Guzud.

items.Name: Obould's Head
items.Description: This grisly trophy appears to be the decapitated head of the powerful orc king Obould Many-Arrows.

items.Name: Vaath's Head
items.Description: This severed head once sat upon the shoulders of the infamous orc bandit Vaath.

items.Name: Diary Page
items.Description:
This appears to be an old and crumbling page from a diary.

"The Mountain Witch is no more! I have defeated the Hag Nebacha in a summoning duel.

"I began with a standard opening, the summoning of a feral cat. She countered with the rather predictable conjuration of a large hunt…

items.Name: Orc Head
items.Description: This is the decapitated head of an orc.

items.Name: Laboratory Notes
items.Description:
These appear to be the lab notes of Cyril, the mage who created this laboratory:

I believe I have at last unlocked the keys to creating the Staff of Command! As I suspected all along, the key ingredients were a rakshasa eye and a quartz crystal. However, determining the proper …

items.Name: Broken Amulet of the Ages
items.Description: A hairline crack runs through the center of this amulet, the only flaw in its otherwise perfect construction. On one side are inscribed strange symbols from a long-forgotten language, and on the other is an engraving of a dryad's tree and a dwarven hammer.

items.Name: Drained Amulet of the Ages
items.Description: One side of this perfectly constructed amulet is inscribed with strange symbols from a long-forgotten language. The other bears the images of a dryad's tree and a dwarven hammer.

items.Name: Arwyl's Journal
items.Description:
This is the journal of Arwyl, leader of the snow globe dryads. The final entry is of particular interest:

The dwarves fell upon us yet again. Their savagery was terrifying, but at last I and my sisters managed to drive them off.

How many times was I slain in that battle, only …

items.Name: Hodd's Journal
items.Description:
This is the journal of Hodd, leader of the snow globe dwarves. The final entry is of particular interest:

The dryads came at us again, using their foul magic. The fighting was bloody fierce, but at last we drove the tree huggers back.

How many times did I die in that battle on…

items.Name: Amulet of the Ages
items.Description: This artifact is warm beneath your touch and bears a weight far greater than its size might suggest. items.Description:

items.Description: This ring is a finely fashioned band of purest gold, though sporadic splashes of discoloration mar its otherwise smooth surface.

items.Name: Hill Giant Head
items.Description: This is the severed head of the Hill Giant Chieftain.

items.Name: Klauth's Head
items.Description: This is the head of the ancient red dragon Klauth. Though dulled somewhat by his recent demise, his ruby red scales still possess a luster far deeper than any gem. Klauth's features are forever frozen in an expression of malevolent evil, his enormous jaws curled into a sinister …

items.Name: Note
items.Description:
This note is written in the flawless script of a professional scribe. The bottom is marked with an official seal in the shape of a dragon's head:

A wise chieftain knows there is a time for war and there is a time for allegiance with and submission to a greater power. The time f…

items.Name: Notes
items.Description:
This letter is penned in a crude, almost child-like hand and there are numerous spelling errors in the text. Based on the poorly rendered seal at the bottom of the page it would be safe to assume this was some type of official correspondence from the hill giant chieftain:

You b…

items.Name: Green Dragon Egg
items.Description: The tough but pliable leather shell of this dragon's egg is warm to the touch, a sure sign there is still life within.

items.Name: Gold Dragon Egg
items.Description: The tough but pliable leather shell of this dragon's egg is warm to the touch, a sure sign there is still life within.

items.Description: A key to the main gate in the War Zone.

items.Description: This is the final word of power, obtained from a chest in Maugrim's sanctuary.

items.Description: This magical sword was taken from the corpse of Aribeth.

items.Description: This amulet was given away by Asheera, a mysterious warrior from another world. Its magical properties will provide some additional protection against Morag and her own lizard minions.

items.Name: Guardian Key
items.Description: This key can be used to unlock one of the massive doors blocking your progress deeper into the Source Stone.

items.Name: Note
items.Description: This document is a short summary of the basic plan of attack that the Luskan force is using during its assault on Neverwinter. Aribeth as war leader, is commanding the army from Maugrim's Sanctuary, an extra-planar domain created by Maugrim. Supposedly it can be reached via a po…

items.Description: This is the key you recovered from Aribeth

items.Description: This key has a sequence of musical notes inscribed over its surface.

items.Name: Key of Light and Darkness
items.Description: The surface of this key seems to shimmer and glow one moment, then become dull and dark the next.

items.Name: Past Life Key
items.Description: This key is unremarkable in design, yet each time you gaze upon it you get the distinct feeling you have seen it somewhere before.

items.Name: Key
items.Description: You recognize this as the key to the front door of the headquarters of the slave resistance.

items.Name: Inkwell
items.Description: This is an ordinary inkwell, complete with ink. If you had a quill and some paper you could write yourself a note.

items.Name: Quill
items.Description: This is a plain writing quill. If you had an inkwell and some paper you could write yourself a note.

items.Name: Adventurer's Diary
items.Description:
This appears to be a set of notes, written carefully:

The puzzle of light and dark haunts me; I know there's a key in here somewhere. But where? It is a strange labyrinth, and half the time I end up back where I began.

I do know that carrying the torch is part of the light. Bu…
